purpose: Illustrative structured candidate only; requires actor verification, NPC adjudication, admin approval, annual financing and national/world recalculation. Not an exact canonical country state JSON patch.

semantics.metric_deltas_vs_same_year_background: Each annual delta is a proposed deviation from the same-year independent counterfactual, not a sum with previous-year deltas; whether earned is checked each turn.
semantics.gdp_growth_pct_component_pp: Percentage-point contribution to annual GDP growth; derived joint macro calculation, not an additional free separate bonus when exports/technology/productivity are already used in GDP estimation.
semantics.stocks_and_permanent_index_deltas: Apply once with unique effect_id and retain resulting state. Do not repeat changes every year.
semantics.exports_billion_imports_billion: Annual incremental executed trade flows over annual baseline; not signed contract face value and not an accrued annual yield.
semantics.financial_costs: Estimated preparation caps only, not actual approved spending. Full program investment and operation need separate annual allocations.
semantics.long_term_programs: Remain tracked with milestones, obligations, budget commitments, last_effect_year; successes can become new baseline, no permanent automatic flat modifiers.
semantics.treaty: Pending signature/ratification not effective and not payable; USD nominal amounts require separate G$ funding convention when applicable.
